draftedFindings.title: first panics when n exceeds the slice length
draftedFindings.body: `&items[..n]` panics if `n > items.len()`, so `first(&[1, 2], 3)` crashes instead of returning the available items. This is especially surprising next to `last`, which explicitly handles over-large `n`. Clamp the end index, e.g. `&items[..n.min(items.len())]`, or document the panic if that is intentional.
